record.ROLE_TEXT:
**Job Description**
The Senior Manager, Manufacturing Quality builds and leads the quality system supporting Harris' manufacturing network. This role owns quality and certifications across multiple facilities, including the ISO 9001 and ASME (non-nuclear) certification programs, inspection and hold/release, and independent verification of VDC deliverables, so products leave Harris' shops conforming to customer, code, and specification requirements.
 
 
This role builds and leads the plant-level QA/QC team, who will report directly to it. It holds quality stop-work authority and provides independent verification across facilities. The Senior Manager partners with the Harris corporate QA/QC program, applying and extending it to manufacturing, and works with Manufacturing Operations, Engineering and VDC, Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, and Safety. The role standardizes quality practices and supports certification of new facilities as the network scales.
 
 
**Core Responsibilities**
**Quality Management System & Certifications**

* Own the manufacturing certification programs, including ISO 9001 and ASME, with documentation, internal audits, and management review.
* Lead certification and recertification for new and existing facilities, including customer and third-party audits.
* Align manufacturing procedures with the Harris corporate QMS manual and manage manufacturing-specific procedures and records.
* Drive consistent quality system implementation across the network.
* Represent Harris in professional and industry organizations.

**Plant QA/QC Leadership & Inspection**

* Build, staff, and lead the plant-level QA/QC team, including roles, hiring, training, and standards.
* Establish and own inspection, verification, and hold/release processes, from receiving through final inspection.
* Define inspection plans and travelers by product and customer requirement.
* Ensure welding procedures and welder qualifications meet code, and manage calibration of inspection equipment.
* Manage third-party inspection firms and their scope, schedule, and results

**VDC Deliverable QA/QC Review**

* Spot-check VDC deliverables, including drawings, models, and BOMs, before they reach the shop, as an independent check on VDC's own QA/QC.
* Audit VDC's QA/QC process and record results, and raise gaps with VDC leadership.
* Track shop-found drawing, model, and BOM issues, and feed trends back to VDC and Engineering.
* Hold deliverables that fail verification until corrected.

**Nonconformance, Corrective Action & Quality Performance**

* Own the nonconformance (NCR) process, root cause analysis, and corrective and preventive actions, including supplier issues.
* Track and report quality metrics, including rework, weld repair, NCR trends, and customer complaints.
* Work with Industrial Engineering and plant leadership to turn quality data into improvements.

**Quality Stop-Work Authority**

* Exercise stop-work authority when product, process, or documentation does not meet requirements, escalating to the SVP as needed.
* Define clear criteria for stop, hold, and release.

**Production Readiness & Supplier Quality**

* Set quality requirements, inspection and test plans, and documentation for new products and projects at the production readiness gate and manage 3rd party inspection companies.
* Partner with Supply Chain on supplier quality, receiving inspection, and material certifications.
* Support customer quality requirements and audits for external customers.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**
**This Role Works Closely With**

* Harris corporate QA/QC program leadership
* Manufacturing Operations, Industrial Engineering, Safety
* Engineering, VDC, and Product Engineering
* Supply Chain, Purchasing, and Fulfillment & Logistics
* Manufacturing Business Development and Estimating
* Customers, auditors, and certification bodies

**Director, Quality Assurance**

**Onsite in Warren, NJ**

**Full-Time**

**Job Summary:**

The Director of Quality Assurance is a leadership role, responsible for all aspects of the Quality Systems, Clinical Quality and Manufacturing Quality for the organization. The Director of Quality Assurance will work with their direct managerial reports, as well as Executive Leadership, to ensure a continued state of compliance while promoting a strong quality culture across the organization for all products, spanning early phase development to commercialization.

This position will be expected to work in a highly collaborative, cross functional team environment, and provide expert knowledge to risk identification/mitigation, strategy and execution.

**Responsibilities:**

* Oversee all aspects of Quality Systems, Clinical Quality and Manufacturing Quality to assure compliance with FDA, EU, ANVISA, TGA and other international GMP requirements for all products manufactured at company (e.g., 21 CFR Part 210 + 211, EU GMP Volume 4 Part 1).
* Provide strategic direction and leadership to ensure effectiveness of Quality Systems (e.g., CAPA, Change Management, Event Management, Supplier Quality, Internal Audit, Document Management, Risk Management, Record Review and Product Disposition, Training, Field Alert/Recall, etc.)
* Will have 6 direct reports.
* Lead and ensure execution of quality strategy for all development and manufacturing activities associated with all products manufactured by company, including external GMP contract manufacture operations or laboratories for drug substance and drug product.
* Primary contact for all inspection interactions with all domestic and ex-US regulatory authorities.
* Provide direction for escalated quality issues as they arise, determining the need for, and structuring communication for, further escalation to the Executive team and/or external parties.
* Lead strategic quality to quality relationships with business partners, suppliers, external CMOs and third-party testing laboratories.
* Ensure the company is upholding to Quality/Technical Agreements with business partners and suppliers.
* Provides input to all functions to ensure clinical trial activities are conducted in compliance with GCP regulations and internal requirements.
* Actively participate in the Site Leadership Team to drive continuous improvement activities and initiatives throughout company
* Analyze, report and present metrics where applicable to show health of system(s).
* Lead GxP inspection strategies across all auditable areas to ensure the company is in an audit-ready status at all times.
* Manage overall coaching, training, development and succession planning for the function.
* Set, manage and monitor budget for Quality Assurance, in conjunction with finance.

**Qualifications:**

* Minimum of Bachelor’s degree required. Advanced degree in chemistry, engineering, biochemistry, or related science field desirable.
* Minimum 7+ years of related work experience working in a regulated GxP industry in pharmaceutical manufacturing operation setting or service-oriented laboratory.
* Demonstrated ability to direct a function, oversee projects and teams. Minimum of 2 years overseeing direct reports.
* Minimum of 2+ years working in a managerial role with direct reports.
* Strong skillset in problem solving, strategic thinking, critical reasoning and decision making.
* Strong interpersonal skills and verbal/written communication skills.
* Excellent computer skills required (e.g., Microsoft Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Visio).
* Strong project management skills, strong organizational skills to maintain a high level of productivity, innovation, and priority-setting to complete assignments on time and on budget.
* Strong business acumen surrounding pharmaceutical manufacturing.
* Some travel required.

**Job Summary**

The Director of Quality Assurance is responsible for providing strategic leadership and direction for all quality assurance, quality control, and quality systems functions across Plaskolite’s global operations. This role ensures the company’s products consistently meet or exceed internal standards, customer expectations and applicable regulatory requirements.

The Director of QA oversees the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of Plaskolite’s Quality Management System (QMS) to drive standardization, process capability, and operational excellence. This position works closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Commercial teams to strengthen quality performance, enhance customer satisfaction, and promote a proactive culture of quality — aligned with the
**“One Plaskolite”**
vision of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

This position requires diligence, the ability to work in a fast-paced manufacturing environment, and a strong commitment to safety, teamwork, and quality—reflecting Plaskolite’s core values of
**Integrity and Improvement.**

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Provide strategic leadership and oversight of all quality assurance and control activities across Plaskolite’s manufacturing sites and business units.
* Develop and implement the company’s Quality Management System (QMS) to ensure compliance with ISO, customer, and regulatory requirements.
* Lead and mentor Quality Managers, Supervisors, and Engineers, building a high-performing team that supports operational excellence and continuous improvement.
* Facilitate the publishing and communication of company-wide quality objectives, key performance indicators (KPIs), and metrics to measure and improve performance based on the input of Process Owners.
* Drive standardization of quality systems, processes, and documentation across all facilities to ensure consistency and compliance.
* Serve as the company’s primary liaison with major customers regarding quality performance, audits, and improvement initiatives.
* Collaborate with Sales, Customer Service and MFG sites, to address customer-specific quality requirements, audits, and documentation needs.
* Coordinate with manufacturing sites, the resolution of critical quality issues and customer complaints through data-driven root cause analysis (RCA) and effective corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Partner with Supply Chain and Procurement teams to ensure suppliers meet Plaskolite’s standards for quality, delivery, and reliability.
* Partner with Product Development and Engineering to integrate quality and reliability requirements into new products, material and manufacturing processes.
* Lead quality review meetings, providing executive-level insights on performance, risk, and continuous improvement opportunities.
* Support Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, and statistical process control (SPC) methodologies to improve process efficiency and product quality.
* Evaluate and recommend innovative technologies, testing methods, and data analytics tools to enhance quality monitoring and reporting capabilities.
* Manage Corporate Quality budget, staffing, and resource allocation to ensure effective support for operational and strategic objectives.
* Represent the Quality function in cross-functional executive meetings, business reviews, and strategic planning sessions.
* Ensure that all quality functions and personnel adhere to company safety policies, environmental regulations, and ethical business practices.
* Build and maintain a culture of accountability, continuous learning, and operational excellence within the Quality organization.
* All other du

**Hospital Name: Ohiohealth Rehabilitation Hospital**
**Joint venture/Partnership/Affiliation with Select Medical**
**Position:**
**Director of Quality Management**
**Location: Dublin, OH**

* Bonus incentives
* Extensive onboarding and training program
* Customizable health insurance packages

**Who We Are**
Our inpatient rehabilitation hospital is committed to providing exceptional and compassionate care to best address the medical, physical, emotional, and vocational challenges for individuals with brain injuries, spinal cord injuries, neurological disorders, orthopedic issues, amputation, and multiple traumas
 
 
Coordinates the Medical Quality Management and Performance Improvement activities to measurably enhance the quality, process and cost effectiveness of patient and customer services rendered. Coordinates the Performance Improvement and Patient Safety programs in accordance with the guidelines and regulatory requirements of Federal and State regulations on a hospital-wide basis. Oversees operations of the Infection Control and Employee Health Programs. Develops and Reviews policies and procedures to ensure compliance with all regulatory and accrediting standards. Collects data to monitor compliance and/or trends.
 
 

* Institutes and monitors the Hospital’s CQI Processes, utilizing data analysis measuring tools. Oversight/coordination of operations of the Infection Control & Employee Health Program based upon hospital size and configuration.
* Assists with the design and compliance of quality processes/activities in the areas of clinical/medical staff PI for all applicable clinical/medical TJC /CARF/DOH standards. Assists with all assigned activities to assure that the hospital maintains accreditation, certification and licensure. Assumes leadership with the Joint Commission and DOH as well as other regulatory agencies with regard to CQI activities.
* Serves as a resource for all departments within the facility to provide guidance on designing, implementing, analyzing and reporting on Quality Improvement.
* Assists clinical areas in developing criteria, monitoring and reporting mechanisms and action documentation related to the hospital’s CQI program.
* Performs basic chart review activities with appropriate staff for outcome utilization, infection control and medical CQI indicators. Analyzes results of chart review activities with appropriate staff and confers with department staff on any case requiring special attention.
* Prepares analysis of significant PI findings pertaining to adverse drug reactions, drug usage evaluation, medical management of acute transfers and other CQI indicators.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Registered Nurse with valid state license. Legacy employees may exist with other clinical licensure.
* Requires experience in at least one of the core areas of responsibility: Quality, Survey Readiness, Risk Management, Infection Control, Employee Health and Education
* Demonstrates familiarity with accrediting standards, including TJC and CARF preferred.

**Preferred Experience**

* Previous experience in Quality Improvement, with Statistical Process Control experience and computer skills preferred.
* Demonstrates familiarity with accrediting standards, including JCAHO and CARF preferred.
* Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality (CPHQ) preferred

**Job Description**
The Senior Manager PQE is responsible for leading the PQE team, ensuring quality and reliability performance of the assigned products wherever they are designed, manufactured, and assembled, by managing Product Quality related aspects from an end-to-end perspective (from concept throughout the entire product lifecycle) in accordance with international standards and customer requirements. The PQE team is also responsible for Reliability Monitoring through ORT.
 
 
**Qualifications**

* Proven track record of successfully leading cross-cultural quality engineering teams, driving organizational performance, talent development, and execution of strategic quality objectives.
* Good understanding of semiconductors and the semiconductor industry.
* Good understanding of semiconductor manufacturing processes (wafer fab, assembly, test).
* Strong knowledge on industry quality, reliability standards, and qualification methodologies.
* Experience with failure analysis workflows and quality tools (FMEA, 8D, root cause analysis).
* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving mindset.
* Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently and with cross-functional teams.
* Customer-focused, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities.
* Comfortable working in a global, multicultural environment.
* Written and verbal English is mandatory.
* Flexible to undertake international travel at short notice.
* Self-motivated and business service minded.
* Excellent interpersonal, organizational and communications skills

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and develop the Product Quality Engineering team, providing coaching, performance management, and capability development to ensure organizational success.
* Define and execute the product qualification and quality assurance strategy across new product introductions, product changes, supplier changes, and technology transfers.
* Ensure effective quality representation throughout the product lifecycle, from design kick-off through production release and sustaining operations.
* Establish governance processes to ensure compliance with internal requirements, customer expectations, and applicable industry standards (e.g., ISO 9001, IATF 16949, IEC, JEDEC).
* Drive risk management activities, including participation in design and process reviews, and ensure timely implementation and closure of mitigation actions.
* Review qualification outcomes, assess quality and reliability risks, and provide final quality approval and recommendations for product release and change management decisions.
* Support customer quality engagement related to qualification strategies, reliability performance, and quality-related escalations.
* Ensure timely resolution of qualification and product quality issues by driving cross-functional problem-solving, root cause analysis, and corrective actions.
* Partner with Engineering, Operation and Supplier Quality teams to improve product robustness, reliability, and customer satisfaction.
* Monitor key quality and reliability metrics, identify emerging risks, and escalate critical issues to management with appropriate mitigation plans.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement (shift-left) by ensuring lessons learned from quality and reliability issues are systematically incorporated into design, process, and organizational improvements.
* Manage resource planning, prioritization, and execution of quality objectives to meet business commitments and organizational goals.

**Additional Information**
Pay Transparency
 
 
The expected annual pay range for this position is $168,000-210,000K. This position is also eligible for bonus opportunities. Please note that final offer amount will be dependent on geographic location, applicable experience, and skillset of the candidate.

record.ROLE_TEXT:
**Lead Quality Strategy & Division Performance**
Own and advance the division’s quality strategy across the full product lifecycle—product safety, laboratory operations, manufacturing processes, customer support, and compliance. This role ensures quality is built into how products are developed, produced, tested, supported, and governed, with clear standards that protect both customers and the business.
 
 
Direct a high-performing technical and quality team by setting expectations, coaching talent, and strengthening technical capability. Drive continuous improvement by analyzing trends, preventing repeat issues, and improving product performance and operational effectiveness.
 
 
Collaborate across functions to resolve customer quality concerns, manage investigations, and implement corrective and preventive actions. Lead efforts to strengthen supplier performance through clear requirements, effective feedback loops, and performance monitoring.
 
 
**What You’ll Bring**

* Deep quality and compliance knowledge spanning operations, lab/testing, and customer-facing processes
* Strong problem-solving and investigation skills, with a focus on root cause and sustainable fixes
* Proven leadership capability to develop teams and improve technical performance
* Experience partnering with suppliers and enforcing quality expectations
* Comfort managing risk and driving measurable improvement in product and operational outcomes

**At a Glance**

**Legrand** has an exciting opportunity for a **Director of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering** to join the **Electrical Infrastructure division.** This leader identifies, develops, industrializes, and scales manufacturing processes, automation, autonomation, equipment, and digital capabilities that improve safety, quality, service, productivity, capacity, and flexibility across the manufacturing network.

The Director of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering advises, develops, and executes operational business strategies with the VP of Operations and EI division Leadership Team in support of EI growth and financial goals. Those strategies include footprint and capacity expansion, factory roles, insourcing/outsourcing, operating constraints, and growth enablement into a multiyear manufacturing technology roadmap. The role provides technical leadership for significant manufacturing investments, establishes common engineering and equipment standards, and ensures solutions are economically justified, successfully industrialized, and deliver sustained operating and financial results.

The Director of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering is expected to determine when advanced technology creates differentiated value and when a simpler process, equipment, maintenance, sourcing, or product solution is more appropriate.

This position leads a focused technical organization that works through plant resources, internal partners, equipment suppliers, and qualified integrators.

**What Will You Do?**

**Manufacturing Technology Strategy**

* Develop and maintain a multiyear advanced manufacturing roadmap aligned with business strategy, factory roles, product requirements, capacity needs, and footprint plans.
* Evaluate and deploy appropriate manufacturing technologies, including automation, autonomation, robotics, machine vision, controls, advanced tooling, and digital manufacturing systems.
* Identify manufacturing capabilities the division should protect, build, standardize, modernize, source externally, or retire.
* Adapt technology strategies to differences in product complexity, volume, mix, demand stability, and operating model.

**Opportunity Portfolio and Investment Leadership**

* Build and prioritize a network-wide portfolio of advanced manufacturing, automation, and equipment-modernization opportunities.
* Define the operating loss or constraint being addressed, credible alternatives, expected business impact, investment requirement, lifecycle cost, risk, payback, and sustainment requirements.
* Determine when technology creates differentiated value and when process redesign, tooling, equipment refurbishment, maintenance improvement, outsourcing, product redesign, or another solution is more appropriate.
* Serve as the division’s technical authority for significant manufacturing technology and equipment investments.
* Support footprint, make-versus-buy, capacity, and capital-allocation decisions with clear technical facts and alternatives.
* Lead the division governance process for manufacturing capital planning and deployment, providing consolidated visibility to investment requirements, approvals, timing, expenditure, implementation risk, and expected benefits.
* Partner with Operations, business General Managers, and Finance to develop and maintain a prioritized multi-year manufacturing plan.
* Monitor the deployment of approved manufacturing investments and escalate material risks involving scope, cost, schedule, technical performance, plant readiness, or benefit realization.

**Technical Industrialization and Standards**

* Establish standards for manufacturing equipment, automation, controls, tooling, data connectivity, safety, maintainability, and industrialization.
* Lead technical reviews of equipment specifications, process concepts, integrator selection, designs, risk assessments, acceptance testing, process capability, documentation, training, and critical spares.
* Ensure new processes incorporate quali

record.ROLE_TEXT:
At Cavco Industries, Inc. (NASDAQ CVCO), our 7000 team members are at the heart of everything we do. We design and produce quality, affordable factory-built homes. We are also a leading producer of park model RVs, vacation cabins and factory-built commercial structures. In addition to providing competitive pay and benefits, we provide opportunities for development and upward mobility, while investing in the communities we serve. Our values are our foundation. We’re constantly striving to diversify our teams to ensure we have the best and brightest talent. We’re deeply committed to creating an inclusive and equitable workplace where each person can contribute.

 

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

Cavco is seeking an experienced and strategic leader within the manufactured housing industry to oversee and direct overall plant operations. The General Manager is responsible for ensuring business objectives are achieved professionally, ethically, and in accordance with company policy and core values. The General Manager has a responsibility to influence core values by demonstrating them. Safety and Quality will be emphasized as priority over throughput and demonstrated in business planning through measurable annual results. Additionally, the General Manager is responsible for decisions which influence operational results including but not limited to profitability, plant direction, product mix and pricing. The General Manager has the management responsibility and authority for the total operation of an individual plant. He/she is accountable for results, development of KPIs, and continuous improvement. Relocation assistance may be offered for qualified candidates willing to relocate for the role.

 

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

The General Manager is responsible for the overall leadership, performance, and compliance of the plant. Duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

* **Asset Protection & Controls**
* Ensure all company assets are properly safeguarded and that effective internal controls are established and maintained.
* **Quality Assurance**
* Ensure the plant consistently produces code-compliant, high-quality homes. Conduct periodic inspections of plant output to validate adherence to quality standards.
* **Business Planning & Execution**
* Collaborate with department heads to develop the annual business plan narrative. Ensure operations are aligned with and meet business plan objectives on a daily, weekly, monthly, and annual basis.
* **Regulatory Compliance**
* Maintain full compliance with all local, state, and federal laws and regulations, including those related to product construction, employee health and safety, and recordkeeping.
* **Team Leadership & Development**
* Ensure employees are competent and aligned with company core values. Conduct annual performance reviews for direct reports and administer compensation fairly and equitably based on performance.
* **Customer Engagement**
* Actively cultivate and maintain strong customer relationships. Regularly visit customers to ensure satisfaction and that company operating objectives are being met.
* **Legal & Risk Management**
* Coordinate with the Regional Vice President (RVP) and Cavco Compliance Department regarding any potential or actual legal matters, including service-related issues. Promptly report and forward any legal documents received for proper handling and recordkeeping.
* **Financial Performance & Accountability**
* Review monthly budget versus actual performance with department heads to ensure alignment and maximize profitability. Identify issues, implement corrective actions, and ensure appropriate follow-up.
* **Leadership & Culture**
* Guide, coach, and motivate team members to achieve business plan objectives. Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and high performance.
* **Process Improvement**
* Establish high expectations through strong processes across all areas of management. Focus on impr

**Job Description**

The Director, Inventory Management & Operational Excellence will lead a new enterprise team that brings inventory back to plan and keeps it there. The role installs a standard inventory management system at Teledyne sites: control of the material coming in, sound stocking policy and planning, and regular reviews that turn data into decisions. The Director leads the program and works hands-on at one site at a time, starting in our defense businesses.

A key part of this role involves partnering with Segment leadership, site General Managers, Operations, Supply Chain, and Finance teams to set standard work, build site capability, and deliver sustainable business results, supporting enterprise objectives for working capital, on-time delivery, and margin.

**This role requires up to 75% travel. Due to the extensive travel involved, candidates may be based anywhere within the United States.**

**Job Duties and Responsibilities**

* Lead standard site assessments of planning maturity, part-level inventory, and forecast accuracy, and partner with site leadership to prioritize and execute improvement opportunities.
* Set and deploy baseline standard work for every site, including weekly action on MRP messages for open purchase orders, receiving to plan, monthly inventory forecast reporting, and documented decisions on excess, obsolete, and aged WIP inventory.
* Drive inventory optimization and working capital improvement initiatives across the organization. Lead tactical controls on open purchase orders and receipts first, then structural fixes to safety stock, min/max settings, inventory entitlement, and planning.
* Own the guiding metric: material and labor going into inventory vs. cost of goods shipped, tracked monthly and forecast a year ahead, so sites act before inventory builds.
* Establish and implement enterprise inventory policies, standards, and governance, including decision rights for buying ahead of demand, keeping excess, and disposing of obsolete material.
* Run the monthly enterprise inventory review with senior leadership, using KPI dashboards to monitor every site, identify gaps, and drive accountability.
* Co-lead each site’s weekly material exception review and monthly General Manager inventory review, then coach site leaders to run them on their own.
* Strengthen SIOP, demand forecasting, and make-to-stock or make-to-order decisions with site planning teams, from opportunity identification through implementation and sustainment.
* Leverage AI-enabled technologies, automation, and advanced analytics to improve inventory decisions, reporting, and business performance.
* Capture what works at each site in a standard playbook and share best practices across the enterprise.
* Lead and develop a team of one Manager and two Inventory Analysts working two sites at a time.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Business, or related field.
* MBA preferred.
* 10+ years of leadership experience in Operations, Supply Chain, Materials Management, or Operational Excellence, including site-level operations or supply chain leadership.
* APICS CPIM or CSCP, or Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, preferred.
* Experience supporting multi-site manufacturing and global business environments.
* Ability to travel up to 75%, including extended on-site periods during site engagements, to work with site teams, run operational revi

**Accelerate the possible by joining a winning Amcor team that’s transforming the packaging industry and improving lives around the world.**
============================================================================================================================================

At Amcor, we unpack possibility through our innovative and responsible packaging to provide solutions that benefit our customers, our people and our planet. More than 10,000 consumers worldwide encounter our products every second and rely on us for safe access to food, medicine and other goods. We value their trust by making safety our guiding principle. It’s our core value and integral to how we do business.

Beyond this core principle, our shared values and behaviors unite us as we work together to elevate customers, shape lives and protect the future. We champion our customers and help them succeed. We play to win – adapting quickly in an everchanging world – and make smart choices to safeguard our business, our communities and the people we serve for generations to come. And we invest in our world-class team, empowering our colleagues to unpack their potential, because we believe when our people grow, so does our business.

To learn more about playing for Team Amcor, visit www.amcor.com I LinkedIn I Glassdoor I Facebook I YouTube

**Job Description**
===================

To manage and lead overall plant operations ensuring the achievement of plant targets for Safety, Quality, Service and Cost. This will be executed through providing strong leadership to the plant team and managing the systems, equipment, people and materials according to the established policies, procedures, specifications, and customer requirements. This individual reports directly to the Director-Manufacturing. * Oversees all aspects of human capital planning & management for the facility, including HC goal setting, improvement targets for KPI's, salary planning, performance management.
* Attract, hire, develop direct reports and create strong succession plans
* Ensure compliance with department safety, product safety, fire protection, Company polices/procedures, and housekeeping programs.
* Ensures effective, timely and well-developed communications for all product associates.
* Manage process control initiatives by ensuring manufacturing SOP's exist, and that they are sufficient for quality, safety, and process control.
* Leads plant budgeting processes
* Ensures execution of plant Cap-Ex
* Lead and ensure growth of CI culture by providing resources, participating in teams, and leading teams as necessary.
* Ensures facility compliance with local, state and federal regulatory agencies.
* Drives employee engagement action planning for the facility
* Leads communication to all plant associates regarding business needs and results
* Leads efforts at Best Practice sharing with other facilities
* Meets safety targets and drives a safety culture and environment to send every employee home everyday without injury.
* Meets or exceeds plant business plan and KPI’s.
* Delivers on established budget.
* Best Practices leadership
* Effective, cost-efficient planning and utilization of manpower, materials and machinery.
* Strong Human Capital planning, development and management for the facility.
* Drives High Performance Culture
* Plant talent to deliver on plan

Our portfolio of brands includes Oldcastle APG, Oldcastle Infrastructure, Belgard® hardscape, Echelon® Masonry, RDI® railing, Catalyst™ Fence Solutions, Sakrete® packaged concrete, Amerimix® mortar, Pebble Technology International® pool finishes, and Techniseal® sands and sealant technologies.

Oldcastle Infrastructure - Built For Life from Oldcastle Infrastructure on Vimeo.

**Job Summary**

The Plant Manager is the senior leader on site and is responsible for everything that goes on inside the fence-line and is the driver of the production process. We look to the Plant Manager to build a collaborative environment between operations, sales, engineering, accounting, and transportation. This dynamic leader will be pushing continuous improvement in workplace safety, production efficiency, product cost, and customer service.

**Job Location**

This position will be located at our plant in Sweetwater, TN.

**Job Responsibilities**

 

* Ensure the plant employees and guests on site comply with safety and environmental practices – lead by example and build a safety first culture.
* Lead production scheduling to meet customer needs including timely delivery.
* Develop a keen focus on customer service and proactive communication across the team.
* Partner with the engineering team to ensure proper drawings and designs are being used during the manufacturing process.
* Purchase material/services to successfully operate the facility.
* Successfully hire, supervise, orient, train and retain operations/product staff.
* Promote and maintain a clean workplace that is “tour-ready” at all times.
* Ability to read drawings, plan production tasks from those drawings, and coach employees to produce product correctly.
* Ability to operate some of the standard tools on the plant floor such as overhead cranes, hand tools, batch plant, etc. While the Plant Manager will not be asked to operate these things continuously, having some of these skills will make him/her a better coach and troubleshooter.
* Be a leader and coach leadership. Motivate crews during morning huddles. Lead effective Mid-Day meetings. Coach Leads on how to set expectations on a whiteboard and have them followed. Lead inventory counts. Promote safety best practices in meetings with other Plant Managers.
* Perform any other duties as assigned by the General Manager as deemed appropriate and necessary by them.

**Job Requirements**

 

* Bachelor's Degree in Business, Operations, Engineering or equivalent experience
* 10+ years of experience working in a leadership role in an industrial manufacturing environment
* Experience with precast/concrete or building materials is a plus
* Proven track record of developing, leading and maintaining a continuous improvement mindset at the plant
* Ability to work on your feet for the majority of the day in a production/plant environment subject to areas that are unheated and/or non-air conditioned
* Ability to work with computer as necessary (Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, AX)
* Ability to lead and direct other individuals and work with other group leaders

**What CRH Offers You**

 

* Highly competitive base pay
* Comprehensive medical, dental and disability benefits programs
* Group retirement savings program
* Health and wellness programs
* An inclusive culture that values opportunity for growth, development, and internal promotion

record.ROLE_TEXT:
Rezolute is a pre-commercial ultra-rare disease company focused on significantly improving outcomes for individuals with hypoglycemia caused by hyperinsulinism (HI). Our fully human monoclonal antibody therapy, RZ358 (ersodetug), is designed to treat all forms of HI and has shown substantial benefit in clinical trials and real-world use for the treatment of congenital hyperinsulinism (cHI) and tumor hyperinsulinism (tHI).

**Position Summary**

Rezolute is seeking a proactive, execution-focused project management professional to coordinate external manufacturing programs as the company advances toward commercial manufacturing.

The Senior Manager, Project Management - External Manufacturing will manage integrated plans, communications, and deliverables across technology transfer, GMP manufacturing, process characterization, process validation, and commercial readiness. Working with internal functional leads and contract development and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs), this individual will align schedules, supplier commitments, and cross-functional dependencies with Rezolute’s Plan of Record (POR), supply requirements, and business priorities.

This role owns project coordination and follow-through, not technical oversight. External Manufacturing Operations, Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT), Quality Assurance (QA), and designated functional experts retain responsibility for technical strategy, scientific assessments, manufacturing process decisions, and quality approvals.

### **Principal Duties and Responsibilities**

Integrated Project Planning and Execution

* Develop and maintain integrated project plans for external Drug Substance (DS) and Drug Product (DP) programs, defining scope, deliverables, owners, milestones, dependencies, and target dates.

* Align project baselines and supplier commitments with the POR, supply requirements, and approved priorities.

* Monitor critical-path activities and progress against plan; coordinate recovery actions for overdue or at-risk commitments with functional owners and suppliers.

* Assess scope, schedule, and resource changes with accountable stakeholders and route proposed changes through established approval processes.

Communications and Cross-Functional Coordination

* Serve as the project management point of contact between Rezolute teams and CDMOs, facilitating cross-functional coordination and timely communication of changes.

* Lead internal and supplier project meetings, using focused agendas to address progress, upcoming deliverables, dependencies, and decisions required.

* Maintain and distribute meeting records and action items with clear owners and due dates; drive follow-through to closure.

Workstream and Milestone Coordination

At The Hershey Company, our culture is rooted in purpose and inspired by Milton Hershey’s enduring vision that business should create opportunity for others. Through our commitment to corporate philanthropy, we create positive impact by supporting communities, helping children thrive, and operating as a business for good. This includes our deep and long standing partnership with Milton Hershey School, where we invest in education, workforce readiness, and hands on engagement to help students succeed beyond the classroom. Supported by strategic grantmaking, product donations, cross brand collaboration, and strong employee volunteerism, Hershey offers a place to work where making a difference—locally and globally—is part of how we do business every day.

 

Location: This role is based in Hershey, PA with an expectation of 3 days in office per week.

**About the Hershey Company**
-----------------------------

At The Hershey Company, we make more moments of goodness through some of the world's most iconic brands, including Hershey's, Reese's, Kit Kat®, Jolly Rancher, Twizzlers, Dot's Pretzels, Lesser Evil and more. Our team supports a global portfolio of over 90 brands, creating opportunities to shape strategies and drive impact across a breadth of businesses that few companies can offer. While many organizations focus on a handful of brands, Hershey provides exposure to a diverse portfolio of category-leading brands enjoyed by consumers around the world. What truly sets us apart is our legacy. Inspired by Milton Hershey's belief that business should create opportunities for others, we have been making a positive impact for more than a century through our commitment to communities, philanthropy, and our longstanding partnership with Milton Hershey School. When you join Hershey, you become part of a company where purpose, growth, and making a difference are woven into how we do business every day.

**How will you fit in the big picture?**
----------------------------------------

The Director, Hershey Lean System & Manufacturing Transformation serves as the enterprise owner of the Hershey Lean Production System, or HLPS, and leads the continued evolution of Lean manufacturing across Hershey’s global manufacturing network.

 

This leader defines strategy, governance, standards, maturity model, deployment approach and capability requirements for HLPS. The Director partners with plant and functional leaders to eliminate systemic losses, strengthen operator ownership and accelerate manufacturing transformation through digital Lean, connected-worker solutions, labor optimization, automation enablement and capacity optimization.

 

The role ensures a consistent enterprise operating system while enabling each site to deploy HLPS according to its business needs, maturity and performance priorities.

**What will you do?**
---------------------

* **Own HLPS strategy and governance:** Define and maintain the HLPS architecture, principles, pillar standards, maturity model, assessment methodology, deployment roadmap and governance routines. Set the multi-year strategy and annual priorities, benchmark externally and translate proven practices into enterprise standards.
* **Lead network deployment:** Partner with Plant Managers to establish site transformation roadmaps, conduct quarterly progress reviews, address enterprise barriers, require recovery plans for material gaps and accelerate the replication of successful practices.
* **Build Lean leadership capability:** Establish role-based capability expectations, learning pathways, qualifications and coaching models for plants, Operational Excellence, engineering and frontline leaders. Build internal coaches and assessors while strengthening Daily Management, Leader Standard Work, structured problem solving, Autonomous Maintenance and Focused Improvement.

record.ROLE_TEXT:
As a leader of a multi-disciplinary team of manufacturing engineers, you will be instrumental in launching new products and capacities at Rivian, transforming innovative ideas into tangible realities. This role sits at the intersection of product design, validation, factory design, and launch, ultimately delivering Rivian's best ideas into the hands of our customers. You will be responsible for leading and developing a motivated team of manufacturing SMEs in supporting all Rivian vehicle products and factories. This position is located at our Plymouth, MI headquarters or Georgia facility and will require significant travel to our manufacturing facilities in Normal, IL, and future locations. This role reports directly to the Director of Manufacturing Engineering in General Assembly.

 

* Lead a team of manufacturing engineers responsible for designing and executing workstation design aligned with lean manufacturing principles. Workstation design supports overall plant metrics of 90 - 95% utilization and greater than 50 value added elements. Start to finish ownership of workstation design from virtual build through launch.
* Support Rivian manufacturing lines and sites and cover factory layout, manufacturing technology selection, equipment design, process design, etc.
* A special focus of this team will be advancing Rivian’s manufacturing technology and innovation roadmap
* Conduct virtual builds, support design validation builds of next generation products and provide Design for Manufacturing and Assembly feedback, collaborating with vehicle architecture, design, software, and other upstream partners
* Define and execute launch and ramp strategies, collaborating with launch, operations, RPS, quality and design responsible teams
* Deliver production documentation such as JES, PFMEA, Control Plans etc.
* Develop and implement processes, standards and workflows to improve team efficiency
* Actively mentor and grow manufacturing engineers and managers through technical leadership, translate vision into action, inspiring from ideation to execution
* Actively engage in value engineering, challenge assumptions and break the status quo

 

* Bachelor's degree in engineering or similar technical field.
* 10+ years of experience in an engineering role related to manufacturing engineering, DFMA, product optimization, manufacturing process or equipment development
* Expertise in manufacturing and industrial engineering principles (OEE, cycle time analysis, DVA, Cp/Cpk, GR&R, ergonomics, DOE, quality control, equipment selection, ROI, error proofing, supply chain & logistics)
* Demonstrated ability to solve complex technical problems using first principles, challenge assumptions and biased towards action
* Proven technical leader that can lead and influence cross-functional teams launching new products, lean manufacturing workstations and material flow processes
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, ability to concisely summarize and escalate complex topics
* Experienced working within 2D & 3D CAD environments, simulation tools and other digital tools in the field of engineering

Overview:

**WHO WE ARE**

As the largest private-sector power producer in the world and the nation's largest producer of clean and reliable energy, Constellation is focused on our purpose: lighting the way to a brilliant tomorrow for all. We have been the leader in clean energy production for more than a decade, and we are cultivating a workplace where our employees can grow, thrive, and contribute. Now integrated with Calpine, our portfolio includes 55 gigawatts of capacity from nuclear, natural gas, geothermal, hydro, wind and solar facilities, with the generating capacity to power the equivalent of 27 million homes. 
 
Our culture and employee experience make it clear: We are powered by passion and purpose. Together, we're creating healthier communities and a cleaner planet, and our people are the driving force behind our success. At Constellation, you can build a fulfilling career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact. By doing our best work and meeting new challenges, we can accomplish great things. Join us in meeting the country's energy needs today and tomorrow.

**TOTAL REWARDS**

Constellation offers an extensive selection of benefits and rewards to help our employees thrive professionally and personally. We provide competitive compensation and a wide-range of benefits that support both employees and their families, helping them prepare for the future. In addition to highly competitive salaries, eligible employees are offered a bonus program, 401(k) with company match, employee stock purchase program; comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits, including robust wellbeing programs; disability and life insurance benefits; paid time off for vacation, holidays, and sick days; and much more.

Expected salary range of $189,000 to $210,000, varies based on experience, along with comprehensive benefits package that includes bonus and 401(k).

Responsibilities:

**PRIMARY PURPOSE OF POSITION**

Manage and oversee the safe, efficient and reliable operation of fossil or hydro station(s). Ensure compliance with all federal, state and local regulatory requirements, applicable industry technical standards and company policies. Operate the plant(s) in a manner that minimizes the cost of generation and maximizes profitability while maintaining the long-term viability of the station assets.

 

**PRIMARY DUTIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* Ensure standards are established and implemented to provide a safe work environment.
* Effectively manage all resources to ensure generation of electricity in a timely and reliable manner at the direction of the Power Team.
* Maintain a positive work environment and good employee relations. Provide guidance for employee development opportunities and timely feedback regarding performance.
* Serve as a change agent for business initiatives, while assuring the human element is understood and considered
* Manage the station O&M and capital budgets to minimize costs and maximize profitability while ensuring the long-term viability of the assets.
* Ensure compliance with all federal, state and local regulatory requirements and maintain environmental stewardship.
* Maintain effective community relations to promote a positive image of the Company.
* Perform all other duties as assigned.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* BS in engineering or business
* Minimum of 10 years professional experience
* Minimum of 8 years power plant (or related) experience
* Minimum of 5 years supervisory/managerial experience
* Professional or technical level experience in a technical role at a power plant
* Operations
* At least 2 of the following: Corporate/Staff, Engineering, Maintenance, or Outage
* RHR Selection

Qualifications:

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Master's Degree in engineering, business or related field
* Multi-site experience
* Multi-departmental experience
* Collective bargaining experience

**Company Overview**

Delta Galil USA, Inc. is a global manufacturer and marketer of branded and private label apparel products for men, women and children. Since its inception in 1975, the company has continually endeavored to create products that follow a body-before-fabric philosophy, placing equal emphasis on comfort, aesthetics and quality. Delta Galil develops innovative seamless apparel, including bras, shapewear and socks; intimate apparel for women; underwear for men, including under its owned brands Schiesser, Eminence, Organic Basics and Athena; babywear, activewear, sleepwear and loungewear, including under its owned P.J. Salvage and Delta brands. Delta Galil also designs, develops, markets and sells branded denim and apparel under the brand 7 For All Mankind®, and ladies’ and kids’ apparel under the brand Splendid®. In addition, it sells its products under brand names licensed to the company, including adidas, Wolford, Wilson, Columbia, Tommy Hilfiger and others.

**Position Overview**

At Delta Galil, great product only matters if it reaches the shelf at the right cost, at the right quality and on time. As Director, Production & Sourcing, you’ll make that happen. You’ll own Sourcing and Production for your programs, from the first seasonal projection to the moment goods land at our Distribution Center, steering a global network of mills, factories and overseas offices that supply some of the biggest names in mass-market retail.

This is a role with real levers. You’ll negotiate the costs that shape the department’s margin, decide where programs are placed and how capacity is allocated, and lead the cross-functional team through every approval milestone, from BOM handoff to TOP. You’ll partner every day with Design, Planning and our Domestic and Offshore QA teams, and you’ll be the person everyone looks to when a delivery is at risk.

You’ll thrive here if you’re a natural negotiator and a hands-on leader who knows a garment down to its cost components, stays calm when a test fails or a vessel slips, and gets energy from turning a complex calendar into on-time deliveries.

**Key Responsibilities**

Sourcing, Costing & Vendor Strategy

* Share seasonal projections with mills and factories early, locking in key delivery dates and a generic TNA well ahead of order placement.
* Lead program-level cost negotiations that drive best costs and help the department meet or beat seasonal margin goals.
* Build and grow a strong vendor matrix that supports the business’s long-term needs.
* Place programs with overseas mills, factories and offices on time, with program-specific TNAs, the right capacity allocation and production plans that hit contracted deliveries.

Production Execution & Approvals

* Lead the cross-functional team through program TNAs, driving approvals from completed BOM handoff through color and components, fit, pre-production, testing and TOP.
* Work with stakeholders to resolve approval issues and testing failures quickly, escalating to leadership when needed.
* Assess production issues for delivery impact and lead cross-functional decisions on quality levels and ship-mode changes to protect customer deliveries.

Planning, Capacity & Delivery

* Partner with the Planning team to support the business at the right stock levels.
* Own and communicate monthly program capacity plans to mills and factories, flagging loading or capacity risks early.
* Keep POs current in the system, hold factories to timely bookings and approve vessel schedules that line up with customer deliveries.
* Build and maintain delivery reports for weekly team review.

Quality & Continuous Improvement

* Partner with Domestic and Offshore QA, sharing planned program allocation before placement.
* Champion critical QA steps before, during and at the end of production so product arrives at the Distribution Center free of quality issues and every customer order ships on time.
* Work with management to improve process flow and roll out new i

**Plant Manager - Manufacturing Operations**
--------------------------------------------

**Location:** Warren, MI 
**Work Model:** On-Site 
**Employment Type:** Full-Time 
**Reports To:**General Manager

**About SLPT**
--------------

**SLPT** is a manufacturing organization committed to delivering quality, reliability, and operational excellence for our customers. Located in Warren, Michigan, we take pride in building a culture where safety, accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement drive everything we do.Our success starts with our people. We believe the best results come from empowered leaders who are willing to take ownership, develop talent, solve challenges, and continually raise the bar for performance. From the production floor to the leadership team, we foster an environment where employees are respected, supported, and encouraged to grow professionally.As we continue to invest in our operations, technology, and workforce, we are seeking leaders who are passionate about manufacturing excellence and motivated by the opportunity to make a measurable impact. The Plant Manager plays a critical role in shaping plant culture, driving continuous improvement, developing future leaders, and ensuring we consistently deliver exceptional results for our customers.

**Why Join SLPT?**
------------------

* Lead a high-impact manufacturing operation with significant responsibility and visibility.
* Influence plant strategy, operational performance, and business growth.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives that create meaningful results.
* Partner with a collaborative leadership team focused on innovation and operational excellence.
* Develop and mentor employees while building a culture of accountability, engagement, and success.
* Join an organization that values strong leadership, problem-solving, and professional growth.

**At SLPT, you'll have the opportunity to make a lasting impact on our people, our customers, and the future of our manufacturing operations.**

**About the Role**
------------------

Are you a hands-on manufacturing leader who thrives in a fast-paced production environment? We are seeking an experienced **Plant Manager**to lead all aspects of our Warren, Michigan manufacturing operation. In this role, you will oversee safety, quality, production, delivery performance, cost management, and employee development across a 24-hour operation.You will play a key role in driving operational excellence, implementing Lean Manufacturing initiatives, and developing high-performing teams while ensuring customer expectations and business objectives are consistently achieved. The ideal candidate brings strong leadership experience, a passion for continuous improvement, and a proven track record of delivering results in a multi-shift manufacturing environment.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

* Lead daily manufacturing operations across multiple shifts, ensuring achievement of safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost goals.
* Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, urgency, and continuous improvement throughout the facility.
* Champion a zero-incident safety culture and ensure compliance with OSHA regulations, environmental standards, customer requirements, and company policies.
* Oversee production, maintenance, engineering, quality, materials, warehousing, and logistics functions.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, and operational excellence initiatives to improve efficiency, reduce waste, and maximize Operational Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).
* Monitor plant financial performance, including labor costs, operating expenses, inventory, maintenance spending, and cost-reduction initiatives.
* Support successful new product launches by partnering with engineering, quality, materials, and program management teams.
* Lead root cause analysis and corrective actions to improve quality performance, reduce scrap and rework, and enhance customer satisfaction.

Are you looking to power the next leap in the exciting world of advanced electronics?Do you want to help solve problems that drive success in the rapidly evolving technology and connectivity landscape? Then bring your problem-solving, passion, and creativity to help us power the next leap in electronics.
 
 
AtQnity, we’re more than a global leader in materials and solutions for advanced electronics and high-tech industries – we’re a tight-knit team that is motivated by new possibilities, and always up for a challenge. All our dedicated teams contribute to making cutting-edge technology possible. We value forward-thinking challengers, boundary-pushers, and diverse perspectives across all our departments, because we know we play a critical role in the world enabling faster progress for all. Learn how you can start or jumpstart your career with us.
 
 
Senior Manager, Industrial Data& Manufacturing Systems Integration
 
 
**Function:** Integrated Operations& Technology, Digital TechnologyLocation: Wilmington, Delaware, Hybrid (other US Qnity locations may be considered)Travel: Approximately 20–30%Scope: Global, multi-site, and multi-vendor
 
 
Role Summary
 
 
The Senior Manager, Industrial Data& Manufacturing Systems Integration will own the enterprise agenda for industrial data and Level 3 integration across our global manufacturing network.
 
In this role, you will identify, develop, implement, and support two connected sets of systems:
 
 

* The historian and industrial data platform, including EMS/BMS, manufacturing intelligence, advanced analytics and AI, and digital twin capabilities
* The Level 3 integration and middleware layer that supports the platform, including equipment connectivity, edge gateways, orchestration, external-system integration, and twin synchronization

The mandate is to make data contextualization and a standardized edge gateway pattern work at scale. You will bring the architectural judgment needed to make platform decisions and the leadership required to align Manufacturing, Engineering, IT/OT, and external partners. Deep tool expertise will be provided by subject matter experts and specialist hires.
 
 
The Core Challenge
 
 
This role must protect plant-critical data flows and proprietary in-house assets, including custom drivers, tag structures, and site analytics, while establishing sufficient standardization across contextualization models, namespaces, edge patterns, integration contracts, and security.
 
Success requires sound judgment and trusted relationships with plants, engineers, and vendors. The right approach will balance enterprise standards with legitimate local requirements rather than applying a blanket rule such as “everything moves to the cloud” or “nothing leaves the plant.”
 
 
Core Capabilities
 
 
Selection for this role will be based on the following five capabilities, balanced across technical and people leadership. We expect sound architectural judgment, not hands-on expertise in every tool.
 
 
1. Technical Leadership of the Industrial Data and Integration Landscape
 
 
Own the platform decisions, including historian versus lakehouse, integration hub versus custom code, the appropriate edge pattern, and where contextualization should occur.
 
You will frame options; evaluate cost, latency, security, supplier risk, and intellectual property value; engage subject matter experts effectively; and take accountability for the outcome.
 
 
2. Implementing and Supporting Systems in an Operating Plant
 
 
Modernize historians, interfaces, and connectivity that plants rely on continuously without creating data gaps, breaking genealogy, or introducing silent changes to trusted data.
 
You will also establish stable, 24x7 support with clearly defined service levels, controls, and change-management practices.
 
 
3. Stakeholder Engagement and Communication
 
 
Build early sponsorship with Manufacturing, Process Engineering, Quality, Facilities, IT/OT Security, Data& AI, and site lead
